description: Idle tasks: script files InDesign runs when it is idle, after a delay in milliseconds. List them, add one, change a task's delay (0 stops it, -1 runs it once) or remove it (Application.idleTasks)

handlerPath.description: For add: the script file to run (.jsx, .js or .jsxbin)

name.description: For add, set_sleep and remove: the task name

sleep.description: For add and set_sleep: milliseconds to wait before the task runs when idle (0 stops it)

name: manage_idle_tasks
title: Manage Idle Tasks
